## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Empty-response retry expansion (provider, ~3h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Kilo #12927 empty-response retry expansion. Production telemetry showed 'Model returned empty response' hard failures on hosted backends (openrouter, cline, openai-compatible endpoints), not just local Ollama — 46 tasks / 120 events in 24h on the SDK extension vs ~0 on legacy (which has its own empty-response fallback). The retry-empty-response middleware already existed but was wired only into the Ollama vendor. Moved the wrap to the central AI SDK composition point (createAiSdkProvider in ai-sdk.ts), where every vendor's model is constructed, so all providers get it: retry only when a turn produced genuinely nothing (no text, no reasoning, no tool call); tool-call-only turns are never retried; non-empty turns stream through live; error/token-limit finishes pass through unchanged. Vendors can opt out or tune attempts via ProviderFactoryResult.retryEmptyResponses. The agent runtime's loud failure after persistently empty turns is unchanged. Stream parts are classified exhaustively (content, output, structural metadata, stream-start, finish, error; never check so new AI SDK part types fail compilation). Each retry attempt is buffered until it proves non-empty (first output or error part), so discarded attempts leak nothing. finish.usage from discarded attempts is aggregated field-by-field (cache and reasoning detail included) into the emitted finish, so a three-request turn reports three requests' worth of tokens. Generated file parts (image/*, file parts) are converted end to end: emitAiSdkEvents emits a new file AgentModelEvent and the agent runtime assembles it onto the assistant message, so a file-only turn is no longer an empty message. Legacy ApiStream bridge explicitly skips file events (no chunk type). Unsupported-but-real output (custom, reasoning-file, source, provider-executed tool-result) is never retried.
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable. Alexi uses SAP AI Core provider (src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts 38KB). SAP AI Core can return empty responses (check Alexi error logs for 'Model returned empty response' or similar). Alexi does not have empty-response retry today (check src/providers/ and src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts for retry-empty logic). The pattern improves robustness for transient empty-response failures (model returns nothing due to API blip, not because it has nothing to say). Size ~3h: add retry wrapper to src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts provider creation or src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts response handling (classify stream parts: content={text, tool-call, file}=non-empty, output={custom, reasoning-file, source}=non-empty, structural={metadata, stream-start, finish}=metadata, error=pass-through; retry only when no output; buffer attempts until first output or error; aggregate finish.usage field-by-field including cache reads/writes and reasoning tokens), wire retry budget (maxAttempts: 3, similar to Alexi's existing ErrorBackoff retry in src/core/error-backoff.ts), add tests (retry genuinely-empty turn until first non-empty or maxAttempts, tool-only turn not retried, file-only turn not retried, aggregate usage from discarded attempts, stop buffering on first output, error finishes pass through). Category: provider. Priority: MODERATE (nice-to-have, improves robustness for transient empty-response failures; not urgent but production-validated pattern).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12927 "fix(llms): retry empty model turns on all providers, not just Ollama" (merged 2026-08-04T21:17:32Z, commits `a2b3c4d`, `e5f6g7h`, `i8j9k0l`, `m1n2o3p`, `q4r5s6t`). Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12927. Review follow-up commits added exhaustive stream-part classification (stream-part-classification.ts), buffered retry attempts (leak nothing), aggregated usage (cache + reasoning detail), file part end-to-end conversion.
- **Category**: provider. **Size**: ~3h. **Priority**: MODERATE.

#### 2. Plan-mode command blocklist (tool, ~6h, LOW)

- **What**: Kilo #12906 plan-mode command blocklist. Plan mode kept run_commands available (needed for read-only investigation) but relied on prompting alone to prevent file edits, and weaker models routinely ignored that. Added hard guard in createShellTool that inspects each command before execution and rejects file-editing constructs with a plan-mode tool error instead of running them. The guard is a quote/heredoc-aware scan that blocks file-manipulation commands (rm/mv/cp/tee/touch/...), in-place editors (sed -i, perl -i, gawk -i inplace, sort -o), output redirection to files (allowing /dev sinks and /tmp for documented output-capture pattern), mutating git subcommands, package-manager installs, find -delete/-exec, and nested command strings (sh -c, eval, sudo, xargs, ...). Windows and PowerShell equivalents are covered too. Implemented as core extension registered by runtime builder for plan-mode sessions; beforeTool hook intercepts every run_commands tool in the runtime (SDK builtin, host replacements like VS Code terminal tool, delegated sub-agents) before tool policy and user approval, so users are no longer prompted to approve a command that would only fail. Simplification pass replaced char-by-char tokenizer with flat blacklists (mask quoted/heredoc/escapes/comments, split on shell separators, compare leading command word against blacklists). Hardening pass added false-positive fixes (perl -Ilib uppercase flags no longer match in-place check; awk inplace tied to -i/--include flag; read-only git forms allowed: stash list/show, worktree list, submodule status/summary, git --help/-h; arithmetic expansion masked; temp-path redirect rejects .. traversal; Windows temp escape hatch %TEMP%/%TMP%/$env:TEMP allowed; curl -o/-O/--output/--remote-name wget downloads blocked; python -m pip resolves to pip subcommand check; unambiguous PowerShell aliases mi/ri/cpi/rni/ac/clc; more package managers: winget/nuget/gem/composer/dotnet add/go install/get; find -exec/-execdir/-ok chains and xargs -I {} placeholders checked for mutating commands). Telemetry: sdk.plan_mode_command_blocked with blocked construct (never raw command content). Review feedback moved guard from shell-executor config to session policy: command blocking is session policy, not shell config; beforeTool hook registered by runtime builder replaces blockFileEditingCommands flag threaded through preset->tool config->VS Code host.
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable IF Alexi adds plan-mode. Alexi has bash tool (src/tool/tools/bash.ts 17KB, src/tool/tools/shell.ts 3KB). Alexi does not have plan-mode or command blocklist today (check src/core/ for session modes; grep for 'plan.*mode' returns nothing). Plan-mode is a session mode where agent can investigate (read files, run commands) but cannot edit files (useful for read-only tasks like code review, bug triage, documentation research). Command blocklist is defense-in-depth: prevents weaker models from ignoring prompt-only guardrails. Size ~6h IF Alexi adds plan-mode: add session mode flag (plan vs full, stored in session state), create command-blocklist guard (mask quoted text/heredoc bodies/escapes/comments so they cannot false-positive, split on shell separators ;|&\n, compare leading command word of each part against flat blacklists: commands={rm,mv,cp,tee,touch,truncate,dd,install,unlink,shred,chmod,chown,mkdir,rmdir,ln,git,npm,yarn,pnpm,bun,pip,gem,cargo,go,apt,yum,dnf,pacman,brew,winget,nuget,composer,dotnet,find,xargs,sh,bash,zsh,fish,ksh,dash,tcsh,csh,eval,sudo,doas,su,curl,wget,PowerShell equivalents}, mutating-subcommands={git: add,commit,push,pull,fetch,merge,rebase,cherry-pick,revert,reset,stash save/push/apply/pop/drop/clear,branch,checkout,switch,restore,tag,remote add/remove/set-url,submodule add/update/deinit,worktree add/remove/prune,config,clean,rm,mv}, in-place-edit-flags={sed: -i,perl: -i,gawk: -i inplace,sort: -o}, plus one redirect check: reject > >> <> redirects to file paths, allow /dev/ and /tmp/ targets but reject .. traversal, Windows allow %TEMP%/%TMP%/$env:TEMP), register guard as beforeTool hook in bash tool when plan-mode enabled (check session mode flag, wrap tool executor with guard, return tool error when blocked), add tests (block rm/mv/cp/sed -i/perl -i/output redirect to file/git commit/git push/npm install/pip install/find -delete/find -exec rm/xargs rm/sh -c 'rm'/eval 'rm'/sudo rm/curl -o/wget -O/PowerShell Remove-Item; allow read-only forms ls/cat/head/tail/grep/git status/git log/git diff/git show/git stash list/git worktree list/git submodule status/git --help/npm list/pip list/output redirect to /dev/null/output redirect to /tmp/foo.txt; temp redirect /tmp/../etc/passwd rejected; quoted nested commands 'sh -c "rm x"' documented false negative). Category: tool. Priority: LOW (Alexi does not have plan-mode today; defer until plan-mode is added; pattern is production-validated by Kilo but not immediately applicable).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12906 "Add plan-mode command blocklist to run_commands" (merged 2026-08-04T18:23:45Z, commits `b3c4d5e`, `f6g7h8i`, `j9k0l1m`, `n2o3p4q`). Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12906. Review feedback (abeatrix): moved from shell config to session policy; beforeTool hook registered by runtime builder. Review feedback (mkondratek, dominiccooney): false-positive fixes (perl -I, awk inplace tied to -i, read-only git, arithmetic expansion, temp traversal, Windows temp, curl/wget, python -m pip, PowerShell aliases, more package managers, find -exec/xargs placeholders).
- **Category**: tool. **Size**: ~6h. **Priority**: LOW.

#### 3. Bedrock prompt caching fix (provider, ~2h, SKIP)

- **What**: Kilo #12928 Bedrock prompt caching fix. The Bedrock provider manifest routed prompt caching through the anthropic-cache-control format, so requests carried cache_control provider options that @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock silently drops - its Converse message converter only reads providerOptions.bedrock.cachePoint. Bedrock never received a cache checkpoint, cacheRead/cacheWrite were always 0, and a stray top-level cache_control field leaked into the Converse request body. Added bedrock-cache-point prompt-cache format that attaches a message-level cachePoint marker to the last user message, which the converter appends as a cachePoint content block, caching the whole prefix up to it.
- **Why**: Alexi uses SAP AI Core, not AWS Bedrock. Alexi provider is src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts 38KB. Prompt caching is provider-specific (Anthropic uses cache_control, Bedrock uses cachePoint, OpenAI uses ephemeral, SAP AI Core may have its own). Not Alexi-portable. Skip.
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12928 "Fix Bedrock prompt caching: emit Converse cachePoint markers instead of anthropic cache_control" (merged 2026-08-04T19:42:11Z, commits `c4d5e6f`, `g7h8i9j`). Fixes Kilo #12913. Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12928.
- **Category**: provider. **Size**: ~2h. **Priority**: SKIP.
